$comment: The specifications polyjose implements. Titles and update relationships as published by rfc-editor.org. implements says what polyjose does with each one.

rfcs.title: JSON Web Signature (JWS)
rfcs.implements: Compact, flattened JSON and general JSON serializations, multiple signatures, detached payloads and `crit`. Verification takes an explicit algorithm allow-list.

rfcs.title: JSON Web Encryption (JWE)
rfcs.implements: Compact, flattened JSON and general JSON serializations, multiple recipients and additional authenticated data. Decryption takes explicit `alg` and `enc` allow-lists. `zip` (`DEF`) is available in Rust with the `deflate` feature.

rfcs.title: JSON Web Key (JWK)
rfcs.implements: JWKs and JWK Sets with key types `oct`, `RSA` (public keys only), `EC` and `OKP`, and the `use`, `key_ops`, `alg` and `kid` members. `x5c` and `x5t` are carried but not validated as X.509.

rfcs.title: JSON Web Algorithms (JWA)
rfcs.implements: Every algorithm marked Required, and the others listed on the Algorithms page, with the exceptions stated there.

rfcs.title: JSON Web Token (JWT)
rfcs.implements: Issuing and validating signed JWTs (`exp`, `nbf`, `iat`, `iss`, `sub`, `aud`, `jti`), and nested JWTs that are signed and then encrypted.

rfcs.title: Examples of Protecting Content Using JSON Object Signing and Encryption (JOSE)
rfcs.implements: Its examples are test vectors for the algorithms polyjose implements.

rfcs.title: JSON Web Key (JWK) Thumbprint
rfcs.implements: Thumbprints with SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512. SHA-1 is not offered.

rfcs.title: JSON Web Signature (JWS) Unencoded Payload Option
rfcs.implements: `b64: false`, which must be listed in `crit`. JWTs never use it.

rfcs.title: CFRG Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman (ECDH) and Signatures in JSON Object Signing and Encryption (JOSE)
rfcs.implements: The `OKP` key type with Ed25519 signatures (`EdDSA`) and X25519 key agreement (ECDH-ES). Ed448 and X448 are not offered.

rfcs.title: JSON Web Token Best Current Practices
rfcs.implements: The default validation policy: explicit allow-lists, no `none`, keys bound to their algorithm, `exp` required, audience and type checks.

rfcs.title: CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE) and JSON Object Signing and Encryption (JOSE) Registrations for Web Authentication (WebAuthn) Algorithms
rfcs.implements: Its JOSE registrations: the `ES256K` algorithm and the `secp256k1` curve.

rfcs.title: JSON Web Token (JWT) Profile for OAuth 2.0 Access Tokens
rfcs.implements: The `at+jwt` type and an access-token validation profile.

rfcs.title: Fully-Specified Algorithms for JSON Object Signing and Encryption (JOSE) and CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE)
rfcs.implements: The `Ed25519` algorithm, recommended for new tokens. `EdDSA`, which it deprecates, stays supported for existing tokens.

errata.summary: Step 5 of JWT validation checks the header by the JWS or JWE rules, so header parameters that are not understood are ignored unless `crit` lists them.
